retro:
# Retrospective: PR 12890

The neutral public packet and direct original/current source comparison made the narrow follow-up clear. Both fresh independent reviewers enumerated remaining writers instead of inheriting earlier private conclusions. No redundant stubbed experiment was needed to show the specific destructive operations were removed. Public claims are intentionally source-only and do not reuse historical native results as new measurements.

Avoidable friction: Opus used nonnumeric initial directory metadata before finishing policy reads and attempted a denied parent-process memory check. The coordinator supplied verified settings and BOOTSTRAP-CORRECTION.md, requiring numeric-only or filename-only listing before the first tool call, with bounded aggregate output. Future dispatches must put these instructions upfront. Sol's first menu diff had a bad revision operand and was corrected; the failed attempt remains native history and supports no conclusion.

No confirmed review-tools/Omadev bug. No tests, desktop slots or private runtime children were started. Source materialization and API transport used explicit assignment-root destinations and separate stdout/stderr/exit receipts. Source-only decisions reduced safety and fixture-audit surface without hiding meaningful limits.

Both reviewers reported only process reminders at startup. Opus auto-memory was disabled session-locally using a supported setting and verified owned launch options. Pi automatic memory configuration was not independently verified, so retain that audit limitation. No intentional memory edits or historical deletion are permitted.

Detailed process deviation evidence is in PROCESS-DEVIATIONS.md. Publication remains appropriate only after fresh editorial and upstream freshness gates, and only through the outer assistant.
comment:
**Verified by source inspection:** the three preservation findings in the [previous review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12890#issuecomment-5785181640) are resolved in the installer at [`8ca4cda2`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/8ca4cda2ef149a8f79adb978bcb7b48c54369c08/bin/omarchy-install-keyboard-nepali). No new actionable issue was found in this follow-up's scope.

| Previous behavior | Current source |
| --- | --- |
| Existing preferred methods could be replaced | Both the global `DefaultIM` rewrite and live `fcitx5-remote` US switch are removed. Existing preference lines pass through unchanged. |
| A local traditional `np` map was overwritten | The local XKB copy is removed; `keyboard-np` remains registered. |
| An existing phonetic map was overwritten | An existing regular `ne-phonetic.mim` is kept, with an explicit “not updated” message. The bundled map is copied when missing. |

New profiles still initialize `DefaultIM=keyboard-us`. The stop-before-edit and conditional service restart remain, without selecting a method. This preserves saved preferences, not necessarily the previously active input context. Older shipped phonetic copies are deliberately retained too.

The installer and PR description now qualify the cycling instructions with the default fcitx5 hotkeys and no longer promise universal initial US selection.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** pinned-source comparison with the previously reviewed revision `e1ed664a`. No tests were executed in this follow-up; package installation, native service restart, layout loading, graphical applications and physical keyboard input were not revalidated.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra Medium initial inspection, fresh independent Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh source reviews, then Astra Medium synthesis against the pinned source.
